mission.title: kyverno: [Bug] Argo CD v3.3.0 + Kyverno Helm chart 3.7.0: CRDs remain OutOfSync after upgrade due to empty metadata maps
mission.description: [Bug] Argo CD v3.3.0 + Kyverno Helm chart 3.7.0: CRDs remain OutOfSync after upgrade due to empty metadata maps. This issue affects 28+ users.

steps.title: Identify kyverno troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your kyverno deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n kyverno -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kyverno
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kyverno -n kyverno --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review kyverno configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant kyverno configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n kyverno -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kyverno
kubectl get configmap -n kyverno -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=kyverno
```
When deploying Kyverno via Argo CD + Helm, upgrading the Kyverno Helm chart from 3.6.2 to 3.7.0 consistently leaves the application OutOfSync.

The diff reported by Argo CD is always on Kyverno CRDs and does not converge.

steps.title: Apply the fix for [Bug] Argo CD v3.3.0 + Kyverno Helm chart 3.7.0: CRDs…
Confirm [Bug] Argo CD v3.3.0 + Kyverno Helm chart 3.7.0:… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kyverno -n kyverno --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n kyverno --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.

resolution.summary: with the switch to the kyverno-api chart for the CRDs the labels are set via https://github.com/kyverno/api/blob/7b64bcf2b1f717ae3ce3987ccdaec7355d879755/charts/kyverno-api/templates/_helpers.tpl#L7-L9 so for the kyverno umbrella chart it means a possible workaround could be to set this (Update: I am afraid there is the same problem with annotations, so we added also some dummy
codeSnippets:
syncPolicy:
  syncOptions:
    - CreateNamespace=true
    - ApplyOutOfSyncOnly=true
    - ServerSideApply=true
    - RespectIgnoreDifferences=true

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with kyverno installed or the issue environment reproducible.
